name: newsletter-lists
title: Newsletter lists
description: Let people choose what they get: several lists as checkbox cards with frequency, one email field and a button that says how many lists it subscribes to.
docs: Pass the lists (an id, a name, one line, how often and an optional defaultChecked), an onSubmit that receives the address and the ids of the chosen lists, a title and an optional description, privacyHref and minSelected. Nothing is checked unless a list is marked defaultChecked, which is what consent rules ask for. Each list is a real checkbox in a card that outlines when chosen, with the frequency beside the name. With fewer than minSelected chosen the button is off and a hint says why; once enough are chosen the hint becomes a count, and because it is a polite status region the change is announced. The button says how many lists it will subscribe to. The address is checked in words before anything is sent, a failure keeps the choices and the address, turns the button into a retry and puts focus on it, and success replaces the form with a status message that repeats the chosen lists and takes focus so a screen reader reads it. defaultStatus error or done, with defaultEmail and the lists marked defaultChecked, shows the failure or the confirmation for a page that already knows the result; labels translates every fixed word and sentence. The cards are not CheckboxCards, on purpose: the check sits on the left beside the name and the frequency is a chip next to it, where CheckboxCards puts the check on the right and has no frequency.
